body.purpose: Default UI text, tables, forms — the base size app-wide.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Resting state for cards, table containers, buttons.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Hover state for cards and stat tiles.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Mobile sidebar overlay, floating toggle button.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Default transition for hover/focus state changes across buttons, cards, nav, inputs.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button — save, submit, create.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7c3aed, #6366f1); color: #ffffff; font-weight: 500; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px; border: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4f46e5, #6366f1); transform: scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.2); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #111827; font-weight: 500; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f8fafc; border-color: #64748b; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15); }

components.name: Stat Tile
components.description: Dashboard KPI tile — icon, value, label.
components.css: .ds-stat-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-stat-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); border-color: rgba(99,102,241,0.3); } .ds-stat-icon { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 16px; background: rgba(99,102,241,0.1); color: #6366f1; } .ds-stat-value { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; color: #111827; line-height: 1.2; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-stat-label { color: #6b7280; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Status/stage indicator — always color + label together.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-badge-success { background-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1); color: #10b981; } .ds-badge-warning { background-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1); color: #f59e0b; } .ds-badge-danger { background-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1); color: #ef4444; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Link
components.description: Sidebar navigation item, default and active states.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; color: #9ca3af; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 500; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #ffffff; background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .ds-nav-link-active { color: #ffffff; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(99,102,241,0.2), rgba(99,102,241,0.05)); border-left: 3px solid #6366f1; padding-left: calc(1rem - 3px); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field, default and focus states.
components.css: .ds-input { border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #6366f1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.1); outline: none; }

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Initials circle leading a candidate/user name — currently authored inline in Views/Candidates/Index.cshtml; promote to this reusable class.
components.css: .ds-avatar { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; background-color: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.1); color: #6366f1; }

components.name: Empty State Row
components.description: Centered muted message inside an empty table body, e.g. "No recent candidates found." on the dashboard panels.

narrative.overview: No metaphor beyond what it is: well-organized internal tooling for running a recruitment pipeline. A dark charcoal sidebar anchors the shell; the working surface stays a plain, near-white paper so tables and forms stay the loudest thing on screen. One indigo-to-violet gradient carries all primary action and selection state — it never spreads past buttons, active nav, and stat-icon accents. Status is color-coded but never color-only: every badge pairs a hue with a text label. Cards lift 2-4px on hover as the only real motion in the system; everything else is instant. This system explicitly rejects bloated enterprise SaaS (dense nested menus, modal-on-modal workflows, Salesforce/SAP-style overload) and the generic AI-template look (gradient text, glassmorphism, cream/tan backgrounds, identical icon-card grids, uppercase-eyebrow section scaffolding). The existing indigo-on-charcoal identity is the anchor; new screens extend it, they don't reinvent it.
keyCharacteristics: Flat near-white working surface, charcoal sidebar shell
One accent gradient (violet → indigo), used sparingly: buttons, active nav, stat icons
Status badges: tinted background + saturated text, never color alone
Subtle shadow-and-lift on hover; flat at rest
14px body base, dense but breathing (24-32px section gaps)

rules.name: The One Gradient Rule
rules.body: The violet→indigo gradient exists in exactly one place at a time: the primary button and the active-nav accent glow. It never appears on text, headings, or section backgrounds.

rules.name: The Label-Plus-Color Rule
rules.body: Every status indicator pairs its color with a text label. Color alone never carries meaning.

rules.name: The 14px Base Rule
rules.body: Body text is 14px, not 16px — dense operational tooling read at a desk, not long-form reading content.

rules.name: The Hover-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadow growth and lift are a response to hover, never a resting decoration.

dos: Do keep the primary gradient confined to .btn-primary and the active-nav wash — one accent, used sparingly, per the One Gradient Rule.
Do pair every status color with a text label (badges, not color dots) per the Label-Plus-Color Rule.
Do reuse the existing card / table / badge / button system for new screens rather than inventing new patterns per feature.
Do keep shadows as a hover-only response (Hover-Only Rule); flat at rest everywhere else.
Do hide role-gated nav items and actions outright for users without permission, rather than showing them disabled with an explanation.
donts: Don't ship bloated enterprise SaaS patterns: no dense nested menus, no modal-on-modal workflows, no Salesforce/SAP-style information overload.
Don't reach for the generic AI-template look: no gradient text, no glassmorphism, no cream/tan/sand backgrounds, no identical icon-card grids, no uppercase-tracked eyebrows scaffolding every section.
Don't add a second gradient, a second dark surface, or a second display font — the palette is deliberately narrow.

Don't use border-left/border-right as a decorative accent on cards, alerts, or list items. The sidebar's active-nav border is the one sanctioned exception, not a precedent for callouts or cards elsewhere.
Don't signal status with color alone — always add the text label.
Don't inflate the 14px body base chasing generic "readability" — this is dense operational tooling, not long-form content.

Don't reference a badge/icon color variant (badge-info, stat-icon.info, etc.) that isn't defined in theme.css/dashboard.css. Two real instances exist today and both render unstyled — define the variant first, or reuse an existing one.
